sara: deploy-bot triggered an autorevert for v3.8.4 — p95 latency spike on chat-route in us-east-1 :warning:
deploy-bot: AUTOREVERT triggered for release v3.8.4 at 2025-10-20T18:14:42Z. Reason: latency_p95_use1 > 700ms for 3 windows. Rolling back to v3.8.3.
ben: curious, there was a partner load test at 18:13 in use1. Could be external noise not code.
alex: @sre-ops can you confirm infra and autoscaler activity between 18:10-18:16?
sre-ops: checked infra: autoscaler did 1 scale up at 18:11, no node failures. Metrics show KV cache hit at 0.18 then 0.76 after prefill.
sara: pattern suggests warmup. I'd rather hold the autorevert and run 4 quick synthetics. If repro consistently, let revert happen.
ben: agreed. @sre-ops please run `deploybot override hold v3.8.4 --by=sre-ops --reason="investigating warmup"` if you have perms.
sre-ops: executed. oncall-bot: Action recorded: deploybot override hold v3.8.4 by sre-ops at 2025-10-20T18:15:35Z
alex: running synthetics: run1 p95=720ms run2 p95=320ms run3 p95=300ms run4 p95=290ms. Looks like first-call tail.
sara: decision: keep hold, open hotpatch to increase kvcache prefill and disable experimental kernel flag. If two more synthetics green after patch, unhold and rollforward. I'll draft release note stub in case we need to notify.
ben: thanks — I'll monitor dashboards and prep rollback comms just in case.
